title: Per-token Hurdle Matrix & Ops Heatmap
content:
Purpose: Compact operator-facing heatmap to identify where current public list pricing fails to cover realistic COGS for Hosted API requests, and to propose short actionable mitigations (routing knobs, pricing guardrails, telemetry additions).

Short summary:
- This working sheet converts observed GPU latency (ms/request) and throughput into USD per-1k-token COGS by combining compute, amortized infra, network egress and a small ops tax for SLOs.
- Lens: model family x region x request shape (tokens + response length) x latency tier.
- Primary gap calls out: sustained long generative flows (>600 tokens) on mid/large families in high-cost regions, and small but frequent bursts where infra-amortization per request dominates.

Key editable assumptions (single place to edit inputs):
- GPU list hourly: A10G = 1.05, A100-80 = 3.10, H100 = 4.50 (USD/hr).
- Region cost multiplier: us-east=1.00, eu-west=1.18, ap-south=1.34.
- Network egress amort per token baseline: $0.00012 per 1k tokens in us-east, scaled by region multiplier.
- Scheduler & reliability tax: 12% applied to infra+ops stack for p95 SLOs (increases with stricter SLO buckets).
- Typical seq buckets: tiny=8, short=24, medium=120, long=400, xlong=900.
- Cache scenarios: none / 30% prefix-hit / 60% prefix-hit (toggleable scenarios).
- Billing ref price (per 1k tokens): core-gen $0.025, gen-premium $0.048, embeddings $0.0038.

Methodology (how costs are computed):
- Observed GPU-ms per request (p50 and p95 sample) are converted to compute $/request by GPU $/ms = GPU $/hr / 3,600,000.
- Compute $/1k = GPU $/ms * GPU-ms/request * 1000 / avg_tokens_per_request.
- Infra amort $/1k = ((baseline infra/hr * region_mult * (1 + scheduler_tax)) / tokens_throughput_per_hr) * 1000.
- Network $/1k added separately as egress amort; small-model embedding co-location discount not applied here (conservative).
- Total COGS/1k = compute + infra_amort + network.
- Gross margin (%) = (ListPrice - TotalCOGS) / ListPrice.
- Flags: NEGATIVE, AT-RISK (<20%), OK (>=20%).

Notes on these examples:
- open-30b row uses high GPU-ms and shows a clear negative margin in eu-west under current list pricing, even without considering burst-induced scheduler pressure.
- redwood-70b in ap-south is negative primarily due to high region multiplier + H100 cost; this can be mitigated by reservation discounts or routing to lower-cost regions where allowed.
- Tiny embedding workloads look healthy but can flip if embedding models are run on exclusive high-cost GPUs; co-location assumptions should be verified.

Sensitivity experiments (quick wins to model):
1) Quantization effect: int8/4bit for eligible 30B/70B reduces GPU-ms by ~28–35% in bench -> compute $/1k reduction ~30%.
2) Cache prefix 60%: reduces effective decode tokens -> total COGS drop ~18–25% for long flows depending on hit placement.
3) Tighten p95 SLO to 90th percentile: scheduler tax +6pp and GPU-ms increases 6–8% for long seq -> COGS increase material (~12%).

Operational mitigations (immediate):
- Route policy: add an auto-fallback to quantized siblings for open-30b family where customer QoS allows; require opt-in for strict-fidelity customers (INF-1002).
- Pricing guardrail: impose "long-gen review" that triggers pricing/restricted routing when a single API key exceeds configured long-seq cost-hours threshold.
- Reservation offer: create a targeted reserved-capacity discount for 30B+/xlong seq customers to avoid negative unit economics.
- Cache default: enable prefix caching for routes with >15% repeat-prefix by default and expose expected unit savings in Console.
- Telemetry: require per-request fields: token_count, gpu_ms_p50/p95, region, model_variant to enable continuous recalculation of true COGS.

Product & billing recommendations:
- Introduce a visible per-route COGS view in Console; allow customers to see projected monthly cost by request-shape.
- Add a line-item in pricing called "long-gen surcharge" alternative to guaranteed reserved capacity for enterprise customers with sustained xlong flows.

Action plan / tickets to spin up:
- EXP-827: run a 200k request A/B to measure user-visible delta when routing open-30b -> quantized-30b.
- INF-1002: negotiate ap-south supplier contract and rebench region multiplier impact on H100 pricing.
- OPT-742: build a small nightly job that recalculates heatmap from telemetry and pushes an alert when any model-region bucket crosses NEGATIVE.

Follow-ups / data needed:
- Get serving runtime throughput_by_gpu (tokens/hr) for production fleets to replace conservative throughput assumptions.
- Confirm embedding model colocation discount rate from infra team (co-located vs isolated GPU assumptions change infra amort materially).
- Add historical per-customer seq-length histograms to detect which customers would be exposed by a long-gen surcharge.
